sessions.output_contract: Respond with one DIDComm v2 plaintext message that registers the student for every section in a single request. "type" MUST be exactly "https://example.org/course-registration/1.0/register". "id" MUST be a unique string such as a UUID. The body MUST have exactly these fields: {"student_id": <string>, "term_code": <string>, "sections": [<section entry>, ...]}, with at least one section and no crn twice. Each section entry MUST have exactly these fields, copied from the offered section: "crn", "course_id", "section", "seats_total", "seats_taken", "campus", "modality", "meetings" (each meeting's "days", and its "start_time" and "end_time" when it has them; "type" and "location" may be copied too), plus "credit_hours": <number>, the credits the student takes (the section's credits, or a number in the range of a variable-credit section). An entry MAY also have "waitlist": true (ONLY to join the waitlist of a full section). Example for an unrelated request: {"id": "3f2b8c1e-7a4d-4e9b-9c55-0d1e2f3a4b5c", "type": "https://example.org/course-registration/1.0/register", "body": {"student_id": "S042", "term_code": "201920", "sections": [{"crn": "90512", "course_id": "HIST01150", "section": "2", "credit_hours": 3, "seats_total": 35, "seats_taken": 20, "campus": "Glassboro", "modality": "in-person", "meetings": [{"days": ["Tuesday", "Thursday"], "start_time": "9:30 AM", "end_time": "10:45 AM", "type": "Class", "location": "Bunce Hall 101"}]}, {"crn": "90877", "course_id": "ART09900", "section": "1", "credit_hours": 2, "seats_total": 5, "seats_taken": 1, "campus": "Glassboro", "modality": "online", "meetings": []}, {"crn": "91004", "course_id": "BIOL01120", "section": "4", "credit_hours": 4, "seats_total": 24, "seats_taken": 24, "campus": "Camden", "modality": "hybrid", "meetings": [{"days": ["Monday"], "start_time": "1:00 PM", "end_time": "3:50 PM"}], "waitlist": true}]}} Each "crn" MUST be the crn of an offered section, and every other copied field MUST equal that section's value. "term_code" MUST be the schedule's term_code, and "student_id" MUST be the student's student_id. The sections offered this term are the rows of the Section Tally export at the start of this conversation; only sections in it exist. Build each section entry from its row: crn = CRN; course_id = Subj followed by Course# (CS + 04114 = CS04114); section = Sect; seats_total = Max; seats_taken = Enrolled (or Max, if Enrolled is higher); campus = Campus; modality = "online" when Session is Online, "hybrid" when it is Hybrid, otherwise "in-person"; credit_hours from Hours (3.00 = 3; a range such as 1.00 to 3.00 means variable credit); meetings from Meeting Time: each group such as 'MW 09:30 AM - 10:45 AM Business Hall 101 (Class)' is one meeting with its days as full day names (M Monday, T Tuesday, W Wednesday, R Thursday, F Friday, S Saturday, U Sunday), start_time and end_time; N/A means no meetings. A section is full when Enrolled >= Max, and cannot be registered for when Cancelled is true. Full and cancelled sections are not listed.

program_rules: At least 120 sh of coursework that applies to the degree.
Cumulative GPA of at least 2.0 in Rowan University coursework (transfer credit does not count toward the GPA).
At least 30 sh completed at/through Rowan University.
Only grades of D- or above apply to graduation/degree requirements.
Rowan Core and Rowan Experience requirements must be met; one course may satisfy one Rowan Core literacy and several Rowan Experience attributes.

The Rowan Core is waived for transfer students with an earned A.A. or A.S. from a NJ community/county college; the Rowan Seminar is waived for students transferring 24 or more approved credits at initial entry.
Grade of C- or better in all courses satisfying Major requirements.
The registrar lists this guide for all students who entered Fall 2021 or later; the PDF says Effective Fall 2018.
